Municipal bonds with legal maturities 2035 and 2040

known_principal_calendar_status: Every dollar in the existing annual 2027–2030 principal schedule maps to a stated maturity or mandatory-tender month. The dates for 2027/28 municipal tenders are confirmed in older primary filings, their principal remains in the 2025 schedule, and Q3 2026 discloses no subsequent change to these events. This is not a legal certification of every covenant or future refinancing.

policy.calendar_convention: Calendar quarters; do not call these exact Intel fiscal-quarter cutoffs or intraday bank balances.

uniform_base.principal: Stated maturity and mandatory tender quarter.

concentrated_cash_stress.principal: 2028 and 2029 municipal tender cash moves from mandatory June to earliest disclosed optional-tender February; other maturities unchanged.

policy.interest: Issuer says fixed-rate notes pay semiannually. Neither allocation is an instrument-by-instrument coupon calendar. The frozen 1.6B ordinary interest and 1.0B capitalized interest are annual analyst budgets; quarterly weights are explicit timing controls. Derivative cash settlements, fee amortization and future floating rates are not reconstructed.
policy.capitalized_interest: Schedule this 1B only in treasury because it was removed from physical unlevered PPE. If parent starts with total cash PPE including it, do not subtract it again.
policy.cash_income: The 1B normalization is unchanged. Allocation controls collection timing, not an observed deposit-maturity or yield forecast.
policy.Classiq: Issuer expects initial closing in H1 2027 and may pay cash or shares. Existing policy assumes 1.9B cash. Q2 base and Q1 stress fit the stated half-year window. The 0.35B contingent payment in 2028 is an existing analyst allowance; no quarter or certainty is disclosed.
policy.escrow: 2027/28 annual proceeds are already analyst performance-and-timing assumptions. No published quarter is inferred. Their shares are reserved once in the denominator; proceeds are financing, not operating revenue.
policy.mandatory_tenders: Use debt repayment under the inherited principal-paydown convention. Remarketing would require explicit replacement funding, not silently eliminating the cash need or adding a second repayment at ultimate legal maturity.
policy.unused_credit_facilities: Q3 notes no drawn revolvers; October 1 capacity reaches 15B. Undrawn availability is liquidity access, not cash, and does not enter principal or cash here.
policy.tax_shields: Parent should allocate existing annual financing tax benefits explicitly and preserve annual totals. A Q4-only receipt control is suitable for delayed realization. Do not infer immediate tax refunds solely from interest payment dates.
policy.interim_liquidity: Use sourced principal quarters with the other quarterly operating schedules. Report the minimum pre-draw economic liquidity and amount needed to maintain the existing 20B floor. Extra same-year borrowing interest, if required, belongs in a separate financing-consistent rerun.
policy.other_asset_warning: SLP deferred consideration is payable no later than December 31, 2027. The inherited model holds its 0.478B carrying proxy as a separate nonoperating asset through 2030. If cash collection is scheduled, reduce that separate asset once; do not add proceeds while keeping the full claim.
